Syntax: map
                |        map <size>
                |
                |Draws a color-coded ASCII map of the wilderness terrain surrounding
                |your current position. The map is centered on you and shows the sector
                |type of each visible room.
                |
                |Map symbols:
                |  {R*{x  You (your current position)
                |  {G"{x  Field / Grassland
                |  {g@{x  Forest
                |  {y^{x  Hills
                |  {R^{x  Mountain
                |  {B~{x  Shallow water
                |  {b~{x  Deep water
                |  {Y={x  Desert
                |  {C%{x  Air
                |  {W%{x  Inside
                |  {W#{x  City
                |  {DX{x  Unused/impassable
                |  {D?{x  One-way or maze passage
                |    (space)  Unexplored
                |
                |Rangers learn this skill naturally as part of their wilderness training.
                |Other classes may practice it starting at level 49.
                |
                |Immortals may specify an optional size argument (6-38) to control the
                |view radius. The 'smallmap' command provides a compressed overview.
                |
                |See also: SMALLMAP

Syntax: smallmap
                |        smallmap <size>
                |
                |Immortal-only command. Displays a compressed version of the ASCII
                |automap by sampling every other grid cell. Useful for getting a broad
                |overview of large wilderness areas.
                |
                |See also: MAP
